{{Quote|What's that? They did? On level three? All right. Copy that. Come on, we've got to go. We've got a lead.|A stormtrooper commander, replying to someone over comm|audio=LevelThree-TheFirstOrderOccupation.flac|<ref name="The First Order Occupation" />}}
'''Level three''' was a level of the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''. When the [[First Order]] began [[Occupation of the Colossus|occupying]] the ''Colossus''<ref name="The First Order Occupation" /> in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> a [[Unidentified First Order stormtrooper commander|First Order stormtrooper]] and their [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] companion visited [[Jarek Yeager's Repair Station]] to question one of the establishment's employees, the [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Kazuda Xiono]], during their investigation into a [[Synara San|pirate spy]] on the [[Supertanker fuel depot|platform]]. However, the [[commander]] and [[trooper]] left shortly afterward after being informed via [[Comm unit|comm]] that the First Order had found a possible lead for them to investigate on level three.<ref name="The First Order Occupation" />

==Behind the scenes==
Level three was mentioned in "[[The First Order Occupation]],"<ref name="The First Order Occupation" /> the fifteenth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'',<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|190|Resistance Revisited|''Resistance'' Revisited}}</ref> which aired on [[February 3]], [[2019]].<ref name="Disney release">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref>
